# DevSec Status

> Automated popularity, momentum, and statistics tracker for Programming Languages, Web Frameworks, Databases, and Cybersecurity Tools.

## Pages
- [Software Ecosystem](https://devsec-status.vercel.app/): Tracks automated GitHub stars, repositories, and momentum for programming languages, frameworks, and databases.
- [Cybersecurity & SecOps](https://devsec-status.vercel.app/security): Tracks open-source security tools, vulnerability scanners, and penetration testing frameworks.
